note: Example props file. Each key is an object id; "gold" is the reference image path relative to the GOLD_ROOT given to run.py --job PROPS:GOLD_ROOT:OUT. size_m is the real length of the object's longest side in metres (post step). Optional: rest_up / rest_up_why and pose_rule / pose_rule_why (see post/post_step.py); noun, description and material are copied into object.json. Other keys are ignored.

pocket-watch.rest_up_why: lies flat on its back, dial up (TRELLIS.2's front, glTF +Z, points up)

hanging-bell.pose_rule_why: hangs from a bracket: its placement is not a resting pose
